balls.text: yorker from Anureet, Morris chips down the track and jabs it to the leg side
well-disguised back of the hand slower one from Anureet, Morris swings and misses. He was completely hoodwinked by that one
short and outside off, he throws his bat at it and only meets with thin air

Miller in the action again, this time pulling off a smart-looking catch. Full toss around the leg-stump line, he goes down on one knee, but does not get enough power behind the slog-sweep. Holes out to long-on. Miller snapped it, realised that he was close to the ad boards, and then regained his balance and pouched it on the rebound. The second grab does it for Miller and Kings XI Punjab
Anureet misses the yorker, has to settle with a full toss, which is slogged away to long-on. The ball bounces in front of an onrushing Miller from long-on
Faulkner jumps across the leg stump, sets his tent in there, but Anureet follows the batsman with a tight short ball. Squirted away in front of square leg
Mitch drags his length back and delivers a short ball, mis-hit pull towards mid-on
Faulkner is fighting fire with fire. Length on middle and leg, launched over deep midwicket and into the orbit
on a length and outside off, smashed away to the long-off boundary. Mid-off is in the circle and has no chance

length again, Faulkner bests Maxi now. Faulkner sinks to one knee and slog sweeps it, gets enough power to get it over a leaping Maxi at deep midwicket. Maxi actually got a hand to it, the ball rebounds off it and falls on a poor little dog
length ball on middle, right in Faulkner's hit zone, thumped away towards deep midwicket, though off an inside-edge of sorts. Maxi sprints across to his right to cut it off
pitched up and outside off, driven wide of point, towards the off-side sweeper
quicker, long-hop from Axar and it is duly dispatched over midwicket with a strong pull. Well, that lusty club ruins what could have been a thrifty over
Axar fires in a yorker, Faulkner keeps it out
slid through well outside off, he attempts a dinky reverse-sweep, but it does not come to pass
pushed through on middle and leg, slammed to long-off
driven to long-off, more off an inside-edge
darted full on middle, Faulkner backs away and skelps it away to long-off. Sort of flat-batted that
low full toss on the pads, flicked away behind square leg, but there is protection in the deep
banged in short and outside off, he swings it in between mid-on and mid-off. His balance was all awry as he  attempted the pull

Anureet strikes back, just as Hooda threatened to soar, his wings have been clipped. He shuffles across off now, Anureet delivers a near-yorker, not pin-point, but it rattles the leg stump. Anureet throws a Johnson-like stare at the vanquished Hooda
not quite the back-away-look-away cut, but Hooda gets a four. He steps away outside leg, Anureet is wary of it as he follows him with a full toss. Sliced away between point and cover-point
Hooda clears Axar Patel.  This was full and wide outside off, he clears his front leg and lifts it high in the air, clears long-off. Not middled, but never mind
low full toss on middle and leg, which is picked away to long-on
arm-ball from Axar, Hooda aims to late cut/dab it away despite danger written all over it. Chopped towards short third man
full and on off, flat-batted drive to the off side
similar line and length, flicked to long-on
full and straighter, whipped away to cow corner
short and down leg, Faulkner can't help it away with a pull
on a length and outside off, punched to the covers
flat and hurled in on off, he flips his wrists and shovels it to long-on
on a length on middle, Faulkner can't do anything but softy block it back to the bowler, his feet stuck to the crease
Johsnon fires in a yorker, Faulkner manages to squirt it out
very full and wide outside off as Faulkner aims to make room.  Faulkner can't make a connection

Whoa! Faulkner cuts loose. This is a length ball on middle, he races down the track and hammers it over midwicket. Faulkner, you should have auditioned for the role of Thor in the upcoming Avengers flick
full and wide outside off, Faulkner seeks to belt it through the covers. However, he only meets with thin air
shortish and just outside off, he cuts it away. Miller flings to his right at backward point and stops the ball

on a length and on the leg stump, Faulkner can't nudge it away to the leg side as the ball brushes the pad and sneaks away to the off side. Faulkner hunts for a speedy single, but has to retreat as Mitch hares across to the ball
he starts off with a shortish one, but the line is far too wide outside off
straighter in line, tucked away towards deep square leg
top, top strike from Hooda. This was slightly tossed up, Hooda takes the aerial route, lofting it inside-out over the covers
flatter on off and middle, he gets n inside edge onto the pad

an appeal for caught behind but it amounts to nothing. This was darted in just outside off, Hooda pushes and gets beaten. The sound came from the bat hitting the ground. Oh well, has Saha missed a stumping chance there? He seemed to have strayed out of the crease after his balance was foiled
He nails it down. Flatter and on middle and leg, swiped away over long-on. Just about cleared the fielder

Maxi runs back from the covers, gets his fingertips onto it, but can't cling on. Hooda aims to whack it over the leg side, shoots it up in the air off a thick edge. Maxi motors back, but can't pouch it
full and fired around off, flat-batted straight to Maxi at the covers. He plays up for a catch, throwing the ball in the air. Clearly a bump
Axar gives this some air and it is chipped. The ball lands well in front of long-on
arm-ball from Axar on off and middle, jabbed down to long-off
Axar shortens his length, Faulkner invests in a pull over midwicket. Sandeep dives across to his right and hauls the ball in. Good effort in the deep
slid down leg as Axar strays in line
full and flat, pushed back to the bowler
straight roller on middle, he tips forward and dabs it to the covers
Karanveer spears it on off, jabbed to the off side
darted flat and quick at the base of off, Hooda flat-bats it to long-off. Not enough power behind that too
he charges down the track, takes this on the full and drives it to long-off
full and tossed up outside off, crashed to long-off, straight to the man there
quicker and slid through outside off, poked out towards third man
flighted and outside off, belted past the diving fielder at the covers. But Miller at long-off cuts it down
good length ball targetting the stumps, Faulkner gets an inside edge towards deep backward square-leg
very full and wide outside outside off, Faulkner does not move his feet much as he drills it to the covers
Binny has nicked off! Mitch Johnson is on a roll #like a boss. This was a teasing fullish ball sliding outside off, Binny is lured into pushing at it and the outside edge is held by Saha.
on a good length and around off, driven to mid-off
hurled full and wide outside off, ignored. Past the tram-line, which means that's a wide
pitched up and outside off, Binny bends his knee and wants to crunch it away. But misses and is beaten

Mitch takes down his Aussie team-mate. This was dragged short and wide outside off, Steve Smith seeks to pull it away. He has to settle with a thick top-edge. Straight down the gullet of deep third man ( not literally). Smith looks back at the umpire and waits as the umpires check for a possible no-ball. It is a legal delivery and Smith's bright knock has been cut short
Johnson loses his radar, hurls it down leg. Far too wide for Smith to glance it away
Karanveer drags his length back, Smith nips down the trick and drives it down to long-on
shortish and widish outside off, cut away towards sweeper cover
very, very wristy! Smith uses his feet, flips his wrists and gets it over midwicket
worked away to the leg side as Karn darts it on the leg stump
Karanveer Singh dishes out a low full toss outside off, he skelps it past the covers. Axar Patel runs across, but lets the ball through him. Classic IPL

Smith shuffles across off, Mitch follows his Aussie team-mate like a deranged stalker. Beaten on the defensive push and the ball wanders away behind point. No bat on ball this over. Ripper of a start from Mitch
Johnson strays onto the pads, there is an escape route, but Binny can't cash in. Kisses the pad and rolls away to the leg side
on a length and outside off, he wants to lash it through the covers, but can't put bat on it
full and outside off, he throws the kitchen sink at it and is beaten

whoa! inswinging yorker from Mitch, he falls over the flick and takes it on the pad. The ball perhaps was snaking down leg. The pair aim to sneak in a run. Miller from the covers swoops in on the ball but fails to throw the stumps down. A direct hit could have landed Smith in trouble. Bonus run off an overthrow
wide and four, that was too hot for Saha. Mitch bangs a fiery bouncer outside off, it leaps up and flies over the keeper
back of a length, some extra bounce and inward zip. Binny is crease-bound as he aims to dab it down to third man, but only connects with thin air
fuller and veering onto the pads, glanced away fine for a single
Smith nips down the track and drives it to long-on
Smith fillets the gap now. Shortish and width on offer as well, his balance on the back foot is perfect as he slaps it away past point
pushed through outside off, cut away straight to point
short and wide outside off, he rocks back and clunks a cut to deep point
looped up on middle, Smith is down the track as he milks it down towards long-on
impressive strike from Binny, that should get him going. On a length and outside off, he props forward and picks the gap between the covers and point with a crunchy drive
Ooops, Sandeep gets carried away. He bends his back and delivers a bouncer outside off, boings over to the keeper as Binny does not want any of it. Wide called
on a length and outside off, caressed away to deep cover

Diving effort from Sehwag, runs across from his right at long leg, dives and cuts it off. How often do you see that? Smith shuffles across and flicks this one away behind square on the leg side. Sehwag does well to intercept it and tag it to Axar I guess
on a length and cuts back in on middle, Binny glances it away fine for a single
fuller and on middle and leg, Binny shuffles across off and mis-hits a flick as it goes only as far as midwicket
short and on off, Smith gets on top of the bounce and bunts it to the left of the covers

Good riposte from Axar and he lets out a roar. Rajasthan Royals have been reduced to 35 for 3. This was the arm-ball from Axar, quicker and flatter. Karun aims to swipe over midwicket again. He misses it this time. But Axar nails the middle stump. It is knocked back
Karun has finally middled one. This was a straight roller on middle, Karun sinks down to one-knee and slog-sweeps over midwicket. Simply smeared that
fuller and on middle and leg, tucked away to the right of mid-on now. Towards deep midwicket
darted on a middle-stump line, cut straight to point
And again! He chips down the track, unfurls another flick. Puts it away to the left of mid-on for successive fours
flat from Axar, Smith makes a statement straightaway. He runs down the track and whips it away to the left of mid-on. Full marks for timing and placement
fuller and on off, Karun comes forward and mis-hits a drive back to the bowler
very full and fired just outside off, he aims to flick. Thick-outside edge skews to third man
Sandeep pulls his length back. Back of a length and outside off, Smith jumps across off and punchily drives it and finds mid-on
pitched up and outside off, he comes forward and executes a good-looking drive to point. Maxi comes into action, making a diving stop
on a length and outside off, Karun attempts a low-percentage lash through the off side and gets beaten
fuller and tails in from outside off, Smith gets another inside edge, this one sneaks to short fine
Anureet bangs a bouncer outside off, Karun wants to pull it away and send it from Pune to Mumbai. However, he only meets with thin air
pitched up and curls in on off, Smith does not cover for the inward movement and gets an inside edge, which trickles away wide of midwicket
on a length and outside off, glided away to the left of Sandeep at deep third man
and an encore! This is impressive bowling. Back of a length and outside off, he does not move his feet as he pushes out and gets beaten lock, stock and barrell
Sandeep generates some excess bounce outside off, holds its line. Karun has a wishy-washy waft at it and misses
back of a length, top-of-off line, defended in front of the covers off the back foot
full and swinging in on the pads, Karun fails to flick it away. The ball wanders away to the leg side off the pad

Sandeep belts out an lbw appeal and forefinger goes up. Samson departs for 5. This one lifts from a length on off, Sanju plays down the wrong line and does not meet with the flick as he is rapped on the knee-roll. It may have just bounced over the stumps. Not too sure
fuller and straighter, Smith works it to mid-on
fuller and outside off, Smith drives it past the covers
back of a length and on off, Sanju comes forward, the ball hits the splice of the bat as opposed to the bat hitting the ball. Pushed tamely to mid-on
Sandeep pushes this full and wide outside off, Sanju is crease-bound as he slashes at it and gets defeated
Smith shuffles across and pushes this down the track
Anureet shortens his length, mis-timed pull over midwicket. That is good enough for three runs
blocked carefully to the off side

Anureet strikes early. Rahane perishes for nought. He races down the track, manufactures a length ball, skews it off the bottom of the bat. That is a dolly for mid-off as Rahane makes a hash of the lofted stroke
on a length and outside off, he stands tall and punchily defends it to the covers
fuller and comes in on off, Sanju moves across and ticks it to the right of midwicket as he opens his account
full and outside off, Rahane loads up for a drive, but does not get requisite power behind it, mis-hit to mid-off
Sandeep sustains the inward movement. Fuller and curls in with some extra bounce, Rahane is beaten, this time on the inside edge as he is hit on the thigh. Mitch Johnson applauds Sandeep's effort
fuller and on off, Rahane jumps out of the crease and aims to drive it through the covers. However, he does not get hold of the stroke and wears it on his pad
on a good length and just a shade outside off, Rahane employs soft hands and dabs it behind point
beauty from Sandeep. Pitched up and teases Rahane outside off. He wafts at it and is beaten soundly on the outside edge
fullish inswinger down the leg side, Rahane does not meet with the flick, the ball brushes the pad, beats the keeper and sneaks away fine
low full toss on the leg stump, pushed back at the bowler. Rajasthan Royals start their campaign with a 26-run win
speared full outside off, not quite a yorker. Anureet Singh misses again
low full toss on middle, chipped over mid-on
darted full and outside off, he can't lay bat onto it
pitched up and outside off, carved up and over point for a four but Rajasthan have sewn this game up
on a length and outside off, he swings and misses

Oh what an insane catch! Superb tag-team work from Southee and Karun Nair. What presence of mind. The fielding has veered from ordinary to extraordinary tonight. This is an extraordinary, assisted hokey-pokey catch. On a length and on the leg stump, Bailey attacks it and sends it into the Pune night sky. Tim Southee goes as far back on the long-on boundary as he could, leaps, plucks out his right hand and takes it. But his balance is shot as  the momentum threatens to take him over the ad boards. However, he has the presence of mind to pass it to Karun, who dives across to his right and hangs onto a low catch. This is one for archived viewing
Faulker changes his pace and slips in a slower ball, he misses the flick and takes it on his pad
low full toss on middle, squirted over point off a leading edge of sorts

Johnson perishes for nought after being hoodwinked by Faulkner's change of pace. Oh wait, the umpires are checking for a possible no-ball. He may have had some part of his heel behind the bowling crease. Johnson aims to go big and holes out to long-off
darted full and wide outside off, Bailey makes room and squeezes it to the off side
Bailey wades into Faulkner. Back of a length and on the leg stump, Bailey tonks it over over midwicket. Away she sails over. Replays show that the ball boy had clasped his hands around the ball
and agaainnn! Speared full and outside leg as Southee follows Mitch, who makes room and fails to fire the big blow
full and outside leg as Mitch makes room, swings and misses
on a length and outside off, Mitch, who had initially backed away, can't connect with it

hurled in mighty full, not quite a pin-point yorker. Axar steps away and misses it completely. Southee shatters the leg stump. This sluggish knock - 24 off 28 balls - has sucked all the oxygen from Kings XI Punjab's chase

Southee hunts for a yorker, delivers a full toss, which is punched back at the bowler. Southee gets both hands on it, but can only parry it away over his head. The ball actually grazed Southee's fingertips and flew over. I am not that harsh to call it a drop
Bailey moves across the crease, Southee hurls it full and outside off, another wide. Yes, this is a cruel game if you're a bowler
Bailey winds up for a big blow, Southee sprays this wide outside off
Axar steps away and makes room, the bowler catches up with him. Fuller and fired, squirted to the leg side off an inside edge
Bailey ventures down the track, Morris delivers a yorker. Jammed back at the bowler
banged in short on middle, another flat-batted pull, this one finds mid-on
Axar backs away, the bowler follows him with a yorker. Squeezed away to the leg side
leg-stumpish, that's in the glancing radar of Bailey. Semi-glanced, semi-pulled to fine leg
banged in short and on the leg stump, Bailey flat-bats a pull through midwicket. Not all that well-timed though
on a length and on middle and leg, dragged to the leg side off the inside section of the bat
inside edge and Bailey gets away with that. Fuller from Faulkner, Bailey wants to drive, has to be content with an inside edge to the left of Samson
looks like another of those slippery back-of-the-hand slower ones outside off. Chopped behind point, Karun collects the ball, hits the stumps at the non-striker's end and concedes an overthrow
banged in short and lifts on the leg stump, pulled away to deep backward square
picked away off the hips to fine leg, Tim Southee mops it up in the deep
aha, there comes the slower ball outside off. He waits on it and dabs it down towards third man
dug in shortish and outside off, Axar can't fetch the pull from there, drags it to midwicket
pushed through on off, skiddy delivery, Bailey mis-times the cut towards the covers
full and outside off, slapped to the covers, straight to the fielder
flat on off and middle, drilled to long-off
Bailey shuffles across and nudges it behind square on the leg side
straight roller on middle, clubbed away to long-on
yorker as Axar steps out, jammed out to the off side
back of a length and outside off, poked out to point
dug in short and outside off, Bailey swat-pulls it over midwicket. He was cramped for room but imparted enough power to find the fence
back of a length and on off, Bailey defends it to the leg side
back of a length and comes in on middle, he hangs back, fiddles with it and gets an inside edge that sneaks to fine leg
on a length and outside off, Axar sits back and lashes it up and over backward point

After carrying drinks or bowling to his India team-mates for 120 days, Dhawal finally has a wicket in a competitive match. This one lifts from a length outside off, Miller looks to go over the leg side. His crude heave translates into a leading edge, which is swallowed by Faulkner at deep third man after running to his right
back of a length and outside off, Miller brings his carving knife and slices it to third man
fuller and moving away with the angle outside off, Miller seeks to dab it away late but is defeated by Southee
that's in Miller's arc and its out of the park. Length ball, slower in pace as well outside off. Launched over deepmidwicket with consummate authority
good length ball around off, dabbed in front of point
Miller looks to step out, Southee bangs it short. Yet he pulls it between deep backward square and deep fine leg
dug in shortish, Miller's attempt to help it around the corner ends in vain as he is caught on the knee-roll
terrific yorker from Tambe, Axar jams his bat down and keeps it out. Axar getting a taste of his own medicine there
leg-stumpish, milked down to long-on
pushed through, he comes down the track and drills it back at Tambe
straight roller on middle, he sweks it away to long-on off the bottom half of the bat
pushed through on middle and leg, wristed through midwicket
floated on middle and leg, turned towards long-on
drifting onto the pads and he does not clip it away. Why was Dhawal appealing? Clearly pitched outside leg
pitched up and outside off, Miller wants to drive it through the covers, but his feet did not move there and the ball moved away off the deck to beat the outside edge
fuller and on middle and leg, ticked away wide of midwicket
Binny bends his back and digs it short, Miller aims to pull/hook it away. Shoots it up over the keeper's head off a top edge
Miller walks across off and flicks this length ball to the left of Faulkner at mid-on. Sublime timing and equally good placement
banged in short on off, he hops up and guides it to third man

that's a yorker right out of the top draw. Lasered in on middle and leg, Miller's balance is shot as he falls over and is smacked on the pad. No inside edge, sliding down leg I guess. Nope, it looked to crash into leg
Miller chips down the track, Morris pulls his length back a touch. He drops it onto his feet off an inside edge
dug in shortish, Miller looks to pull and misses. Hit on the thigh as the ball bounces on its way to slip
fuller and outside off, mistimed drive to mid-off
back of a length and outside off, scythed over cover-point
back of a length and hurries on off, chopped in front of point
pitched up on off, driven to the man at mid-on
Binny veers down leg, Miller can't flick it away

Binny lets out an appeal for caught behind, has Miller nicked off? This was on a good length and seams away outside off, beating Miller on the outside edge. There was a sound there, but no snick on that

Another direct hit from Sanju, Vijay is in trouble, Vijay is in trouble. Vijay has to go. He is caught short. OUT flashes on the big screen. This was marginally back of a length and on middle, tucking Axar up for room, the batsman stays back and chops it to the keeper before setting off. Sanju moves to his left and is quick onto the ball and fires another direct hit at the striker's end, this one an under-arm throw
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped away past midwicket
picked away off the hips with a not-so-strong-looking pull
short on off, Axar aims for a pull, gets a bottom edge towards short third man
back of a length and sliding across off as Axar cuts and only meets with thin air. Wided called, past the tram-line
fired at 90.3ks, Vijay's head falls over, but he jabs his bat down in the nick of time and digs it out
lobbed up on middle and leg, Vijay comes forward and aims to flick it away but misses and is rapped on the pad
full and outside off, he takes a step forward and drives it down to long-off
dragged short and wide outside off, Axar camps on the back foot and slaps it away past the covers.. Sweeper can't cut that off
flighted on off, Axar flicks it away to long-on
slid through on off, he drills a drive to long-off
Dhawal dives to his right and fine leg and cuts off what would have been a four. Leg-stump ball, eased away fine
bouncer from Faulkner, homing in on the chest. Vijay somehow fends it to the off side
dug in short on off, Axar swivels on the back foot and pulls it away to deep midwicket, where Hooda mops it up
darted full on off, drilled straight to the fielder at mid-off
good length on middle, pushed back to the bowler
Axar is beaten soundly. Good length outside off, draws Axar into having a lousy little poke at it
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped away to midwicket
back of a length and cuts back in, cramping Vijay for room, who gets an inside edge onto the pads
french-cut and four. Slower cutter on middle, he is a leap year early into the slog. The inside-edge evades the stumps and sneaks away fine and Kularni throws his head back in depair
good length ball on the fourth-stump line, whisked to mid-on
bumper outside off from Kulkarni, Vijay half-ducks and gets his noggin out of the way. Wided called
fuller on middle, blocked into the covers
back of a length and outside off, punched to the covers

Southee completes a fine catch, no Maxwell magic today for Kings XI Punjab. Maxwell backs away and aims to smash this back of a length ball away over the off side, but does not get hold of it as he can only splice it. Southee moves to his left from mid-off, dives and snaffles the take
good length outside off, sort of sticks in the pitch to foil Maxwell drive. Nearly lobbed it to the covers
on a good length and on middle and leg, Maxwell stands and nearly delivers. Might have been a slower one, he chips it over mid-on. Too much work to do for Tambe
fuller and on middle, Vijay tucks it away to the leg side for a single
Faulkner errs down leg, Vijay just tickles it fine. Very minimal effort required to put those away
fuller and on middle and leg, clipped straight to mid-on
back of a length, rears up on an off-stump line to trouble Vijay, who hops up and stabs it away towards third man
on a length and on the stumps, Maxi flips his wrists elaborately and whips it over midwicket
Maxi gets lucky. Back of a length and outside off, jabs back in late to catch Maxwell by surprise. He pushes at it as his bottom hand comes off the bat, the inside edge whizzes past the stumps
Vijay rides the bounce of this back-of-a-length offering outside off and glides it to third man
Vijay semi-steers, semi-drives and finds point
on a good length and around off, blocked to the off side

Samson reaps reward for alertness. This was fired down leg, Saha can't lay bat onto it. The ball clips Saha's boot on its way to Samson, who moves to his left and collects the ball. Having realised that Saha had strayed out of the crease in search of a quick single, he lasers a throw and hits the stumps and that too with the gloves on. What was Saha doing there?
full and wide outside off, Saha uses the pace of Southee to his advantage and dabs it late to third man. There is a fielder in the deep, but he is squarer
back of a length and outside off, he drives it to point, who dives to his left and stops the ball
Southee slices Vijay into half, nearly gives him a vasectomy. Back of a length and cuts back in from outside off, Vijay was playing for the away-going ball and is beaten on the inside edge

Vijay brings his wrists to play, aided by some sloppy fielding. Fuller and on off, Vijay takes it from there and flicks it. Dhawal Kulkarni gets across and lets the ball through him. Phew, talk about rustiness
fuller and outside off, he lays into a nice-looking drive. Faulkner dives to his left at mid-off and takes pace off it
whatashot from Vijay! 141ks, back of a length and outside off. Vijay does not care as he launches it over the long-on fence with nonchalance
Vijay dabs this back-of-a-length ball to the covers
intent from Vijay, though he hardly timed it. On a length and on off, he comes down the track and lifts it over the covers, more off the outer half of the bat
full again but Morris errs in line as he slides it down leg. Sanju flings to his left and pouches the ball
fuller and on off and middle, Vijay hangs back and tucks it to the leg side, but can't find the gap
slightly back of a length and outside off, punchily driven to backward point, diving save there
fuller and on middle and leg, Vijay twirls his wrists and flicks it in the gap between midwicket and mid-on
on a good length and curls away a bit close to off, poked out behind point
And  Vijay has put this away in some style. Pitched further up and outside off, Vijay does not need a second invitation to drive, crunched through the covers
Southee spills this one down leg, back of a length and Vijay can't put it away
fullish and swinging away, the new man, Saha covers for the swing and drives it past mid-off and gets off the mark

Sehwag gone for a golden duck, Southee delivers the customary early breakthrough. Watto and Dravid look pleased in the dug-out. This was full and moving across Viru, who chases it only to nick it through. The outside edge is well held by Sanju, diving across to his right. I guess his son will be teased more in school, fourth golden duck in IPL for Sehwag
